sources.checked_claim: Custom getter runs each time property is accessed; custom setter runs on assignment except during initialization.
Default get/set generate backing field when stored value is needed; field accesses it from custom accessor; computed isEmpty does not need one.
Explicit backing field is a separate syntax with documented restrictions; it differs from ordinary accessor form in examples/theory.
